architectural-decision-records.why: records the zero-step hook-arming decision and its limits
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0050: a prepare-script + install-hooks helper arm the pre-push hook on npm install, no-clobber, never failing the install; npm-only limit stated
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the helper and the genesis wiring each ship discrimination tests
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added install-hooks helper tests (arms a fresh repo, preserves an existing core.hooksPath, never fails outside git) and genesis tests (adds a prepare script, preserves an existing one); confirmed end to end
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change adds executable code, so the test level is explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: fixture-driven tests run the real helper and the real generator; the right level for a lifecycle-script install, no integration surface beyond that
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the added code; the behavior is the sync-drift local-hook convenience
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: implements the zero-step arming of the pre-push hook the bootstrap-v2 design assumes, with discrimination tests
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: the helper runs git config and genesis edits a consumer package.json
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: the helper never clobbers an existing core.hooksPath and never throws (cannot break npm install); genesis adds the prepare key non-destructively (preserves other scripts, captures the original for rollback) and never overwrites an existing prepare
quotes: For the change in front of you, look up the matching sheet in the catalog below

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the limits rather than overclaiming
skeptical-audit.what: documented that the auto-arm is npm-only (the trigger is the prepare lifecycle), and that the hook stays a bypassable convenience with CI as the authority
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: will run a fresh-context judge-arch review over the helper, the genesis wiring, the tests, and the ADR before opening the PR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

release-deployment-safety.why: a local developer convenience; nothing deployed, migrated, or released

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: CI/dev tooling; no system, data, or resilience architecture change

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or migration

arch-encode.why: planned machinery, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake
